text:
maria: FYI noticed a weird p99 spike on staging for long-context tests this morning. memory climbs steadily and then a bunch of in-flight batches stall. looks like KV cache paging + cont-batch merge are interacting badly.

lee: ugh, can you drop the repro steps and a screenshot of the timeline?

maria: repro: run longctx-loadtest (20k tokens), cont-batching enabled, default merge=on. observed at ~30m. attach flame: https://perf.internal/flames/2067890123

devon: saw this locally too. quick log snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T10:12:11Z] kvcache: page-in 512B slot=0x7fffa3e
[2026-04-02T10:12:11Z] batch-merge: merged 16 -> 1 ctx_id=0x2a
[2026-04-02T10:12:11Z] hol-block: waiting for kvslot reclaim
[2026-04-02T10:12:12Z] mem: heap+23% (growth trending)
```

ash: is this the same regression as the earlier fragment-evict work? or a new path?

maria: different. earlier was fragmentation causing higher eviction churn. this is a head-of-line blocking pattern when cont-batcher merges many short-requests that reference large KV prefixes. merge causes tight ordering, one slow page-in stalls all merged requests.

lee: interesting — kernel-selection could matter here if some models use fused kernels that prolong single-token generation, amplify HOL.

devon: i profiled allocator + io wait. main hotspot is kvfetch->pagefault->contbatch hold. flame shows long stack under `kv_pager_fetch` while merge holds batch mutex. "merge" is keeping batch leader pinned.

ci-bot: automl/regression-detect reported: p99 latency +42% (staging longctx) compared to baseline 2060000000.

ash: proposed short-term mitigation: add a conditional in batch merge to skip merging when estimated kv-page-in-size > 64KB or when ctx_length > 4096. simple gate to reduce HOL.

maria: tried a quick patch: `batch.merge.skip_if_kv_pressure=true` — ran 2 runs, p99 dropped back ~18%, memory growth flattens. patch diff:
```
- if (can_merge()) merge_batch();
+ if (can_merge() && !kv.pressure_high()) merge_batch();
```

lee: nice. what's the detection heuristic for kv.pressure_high()? per-shard pending-pages > 4 && inflight_page_bytes > 65536 ?

maria: exactly that for prototype.

devon: longer-term: we should decouple batch leader from page-in critical path. maybe allow batch merge to produce sub-batches that can proceed independently once their required KV slots are page-ready. like split-merge semantics.

ash: agree. also consider prefetch hints from kernel-selection: some models have predictable prefix sizes; prefetch likely reduces stall window. plus quantized kernels might change timing shape.

lee: can we add metrics to track "merged-batches-blocked-by-kv" and "avg-kv-page-latency-by-merge-size"? want to correlate merge size to HOL impact.

maria: already added counters in staging: `kvcache.merge_block_count`, `kvcache.page_wait_ms.hist`.

devon: will run experiments with merge threshold tuned and with `batch.split_on_kv_miss=true`. schedule perf run for tomorrow morning, 09:00 PT.

ash: assign follow-ups:
- devon: run perf matrix (merge on/off, split_on_kv_miss on/off, kernel variants) and post results.
- maria: stabilize heuristic and add unit tests for gating logic.
- lee: add dashboard charts for the new metrics and hook alert if merged_block_count > 1000/hr.

maria: thanks — will post results here. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy created: staging/kv-merge-gate/2067890200 -> started
